entities.name: Frans Anatolius Sjöström
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Frans Anatolius Sjöström was a Finland Swedish architect. He was born in Turku and educated there and, in 1868, at the Royal Swedish Academy of Arts. In 1872 he designed the old building of the Helsinki University of Technology. He died in Rönnskär.

entities.summary: Frans Anatolius Sjöström was a Finland Swedish architect. He was born in Turku and educated there and, in 1868, at the Royal Swedish Academy of Arts. In 1872 he designed the old building of the Helsinki University of Technology. He died in Rönnskär.
